data.name: albumentations
data.description: Fast, flexible, and advanced augmentation library for deep learning, computer vision, and medical imaging. Albumentations offers a wide range of transformations for both 2D (images, masks, bboxes, keypoints) and 3D (volumes, volumetric masks, keypoints) data, with optimized performance and seamless integration into ML workflows.
